cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. My tea's stronger than yours. I can handle it without milk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Same teapot. I added milk so I could drink mine sooner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. First to finish, then. I've only got two mouthfuls left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fewest refills wins, then. I can make these two mouthfuls last all breakfast.

mechanism: A grants permission to compete and changes the approved measure whenever B gains an advantage, preserving personal supremacy.
confusable: A sore loser changes rules; this Stance must treat B practical requests as applications governed by A rank.
comparison: The tea scene compares pace and refills, distinct from dinner cost and selection of a biased judge.
seedUse: D19-b provides a finished-cup contribution causing the refill criterion; S01 turns that pivot into approval of B request for another cup.
